text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard someone calling for me 
around here, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is nobody here? ...Must have been hearing 
things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The statue of the Three Goddesses... huh.
